title: New AI Game Demo - Seeking Your Creative Gameplay Ideas!
author: Comprehensive-Fan443
selftext:
🎮🤖 Greetings, Reddit gamers!

I'm developing a game with a nod to AI Dungeon's storytelling freedom and I'm looking to infuse it with more structured gameplay elements. 
The goal is to create an AI-powered world that's tailored by your creativity but also features a more quantifiable approach to adventures.

📹 I've put together a brief demo video showcasing the core gameplay and AI elements. I'm eager to hear your thoughts and suggestions!

✨ I'm particularly interested in hearing your answers to the following questions:
1.	What innovative gameplay elements are you most excited to see in an AI-powered game?
2.	Are there any specific features or mechanics in AI games that you find especially engaging or appealing?
3.	If you could envision your dream AI game, what would it look like?

🙏 Your feedback is invaluable and will directly influence the game's further development. I'm looking forward to your creative insights and ideas!
Thank you for your time and support!

comments.author: Bitterowner
comments.body: Impressive. A step in a new direction for gaming. Though for me personally, I would Love to create a personal tailored MUD game.

replies.author: Comprehensive-Fan443
replies.body: I'm glad you like it. MUD is a great suggestion, thank you.

comments.author: Bloodwarriorguru
comments.body: 1 Being able to not follow a complete streight path, 2 somewhat of coherent story and keeps track of npcs, 3 it being able to actually remember stuff and keep track the whole game

replies.author: Comprehensive-Fan443
replies.body:
Thank you for your suggestion. I am actually working on something related:
1. It is possible to preset chance encounters at specific locations, though generating random events is also an option.
2. NPCs are controlled by individual AI agents, with records of each character's actions. I'm currently hoping that the AI can also play the role of a companion, adventuring with real players as they did in the past.
3. This is more difficult to implement, and I am still trying. I aim to enable the AI to autonomously generate and read JSON files, which contain information about entities for the various classes.
